items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Quartet is … Jun Kawaguchi… We used to call [him] “Omasuzu,” that‟s his nickname. And he couldn‟t really understand, you know, the things … I had to write it, all the notes, so it‟s the kind of right notes to play….

ctx.x: So who were the original personnel of your quartet, your first group?

Quartet is … Jun Kawaguchi—he also died, he was a young man, but—he was then a bass player. We used to call [him] “Omasuzu,” that‟s his nickname. And he couldn‟t really understand, you know, the things … I had to write it, all the notes, so it‟s the kind of right notes to play….
So you had to write out all the walking bass [lines]? Everything? [laughs]
